canonical_claim.template: In 2025, Jpmorgan Chase Bank, Na denied {value} of its 3,035 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: Jpmorgan Chase Bank, Na decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: Jpmorgan Chase Bank, Na will deny any specific future application with 42.2% probability
Jpmorgan Chase Bank, Na is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant

42.2% applies to Jpmorgan Chase Bank, Na's non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.
